page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p-redis.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs derived from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core, and has a 35 MB L3 cache. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that this instance delivers modest compute performance. Both single-core and multi-core stress-ng tests place the CPU performance in the bottom 25% tier. Similarly, PassMark CPU and database operations scores fall into the weak category. However, memory performance is relatively stronger, with the PassMark memory score reaching the average tier, supported by a cached read-only memory bandwidth of 195.69 GB/sec. Large block uncached read and write bandwidths are measured at 25.91 GB/sec and 22.82 GB/sec, respectively.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation but lower-tier processing benchmarks, the ecs.re6p-redis.xlarge offers a stable, non-shared resource profile suitable for workloads that require predictable execution without high compute demands. It is best suited for general-purpose applications, lightweight database operations, basic web serving, and caching tasks where memory stability is prioritized over raw processing speed.
